data.description: 休息室的沙发，她双手捧着智能手机如临大敌，指尖悬在屏幕上方迟迟不敢点下去；终于误触弹出满屏通知，她对着手机微微鞠躬道歉——旧时代死神的日常战役。
data.promptProse: Kanna sits on the rest-room sofa in a pale-pink cardigan and dark trousers, holding a smartphone in both hands while her fingertip hesitates above the screen. After an accidental tap brings numerous notifications, she gives the phone an apologetic little bow. The medium view includes the sofa back and side table behind. Soft room light illuminates her tentative expression and cardigan folds, while screen light catches the suspended fingertip.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 智能手机苦战中
